# Werewolves
[color=#999999][italic]"Awoo!"[/italic][/color]
[color=#ff0000]NOTE: Currently in development, please report any bugs or design difficulties via the discord![/color]
As a werewolf, you are completely pacified as a human. But as the energies of the world shift, so will you! Becoming a vicious killing machine for a limited time. Use this to kill the crew and devour their heart!
You will know you are able to transform, a popup visible only to you will appear. You can then shed your old body leaving a pile of gibs and blood to wreak havoc.
This bloody mess will have your DNA and should it be found, points right to you!
## Abilities As a werewolf, you are attuned to the stars. After fifteen minutes you will be alerted you are able to transform, this will last five minutes and reoccur every 20 minutes.
As a werewolf, you are very fast, resilient to damage and hit very hard! But, you are very vulnerable to holy damage while in your wolf form. You will continuously heal damage. But not holy damage!
While a human, you are indistinguishable from a normal crewmember but are completely pacified.
You have access to a leap ability that lets you cover distance very quickly and stun anyone you dash into.
## To counter a werewolf
To counter a werewolf, you should aim to find them in their human form, track them down and contain them while they are human.
If they prove too difficult to contain, consider execution.
